Board & Batten

Hidden Fastener Metal Siding

The Classic Look, Reinvented in Steel

Board & Batten Hidden Fastener Metal Siding is designed for a wide range of residential designs this panel offers a simple but beautiful look that homeowners appreciate.

From Woodgrains to Textured finishes there are lots of options to ensure you get the look you want. All our finishes offer long life and outstanding performance for years of enjoyment.

Specifications

  • Weather-tight connection with no exposed fasteners
  • Installs easily without need for clips
  • Superior 40 year warranty
  • 10″ coverage
  • Standard lengths from 5′ to 20′.
  • Attractive colour options including our textured and pattern series finishes.
  • Wall installation only
  • Substrate: minimum 1/2” plywood with an approved underlayment.
